note: Hand-derived from the subtitle rules in PLAN.md §3, not from any implementation. Tags and ASS override blocks are removed rather than escaped, and no cue ever loses a word.

parserNotes.crlf: input is CRLF; a parser must normalise before splitting on blank lines, or every block keeps a trailing \r and no timestamp matches
parserNotes.ordering: cue 5 has no hours field and starts at 10500, so it sorts BETWEEN cues 4 and 6. A parser that trusts file order rather than sorting by startMs still passes this fixture; one that mis-parses the missing hours field puts it at 630000 and fails the window assertions.
parserNotes.cueSettings: cue 9's end timestamp is followed by WebVTT-style cue settings on the same line. They must be discarded, not parsed as part of the time.
